areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Specific objective, product and indicator on support network, specialized care and economic autonomy of women; very small resources and low-relevance impact give minimal level.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Integrated mobility, urban infrastructure, green infrastructure and social protection actions; relevant indicators and targets; significant resources concentrated here; high impact.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Specific objective on green areas, a new municipal park, reforestation and recovery of degraded areas, with aligned indicators and relevant resources; general objective only indirectly related; moderate impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Requalification of a drainage channel to reduce recurrent flooding; reasonable but not very relevant indicator and feasible target; resources not precisely identified, so low impact.

areas.name: Competitiveness
